description: Our own news from a calendar date in earlier years: the stories 5 or more outlets covered on that date, most covered first, grouped by year with the newest year first, each with its outlet count and, on the plans that have it, who reported it first. Use it for "what was in the news on this day last year?" or "what did the press cover on 20 November in earlier years?". Reaches as far back as the plan's history. Example: date "11-20", years "1,2".

date.description: The day as MM-DD, such as 11-20

section.description: A section's slug, such as world

years.description: Years ago, comma separated: 1,5,10. Left out: every earlier year held

name: on_this_day
title: On This Day
